name: Aizawa Yuuichi
source: With his parents having moved overseas for work, he finds himself staying with [url=https://vndb.org/c2943]his aunt[/url] who he often visited as a child. For some reason, he doesn't quite remember the details of what happened in this town. Having transfered schools as well, he ends up in the same class as [url=https://vndb.org/c2928]Nayuki[/url].
